Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 05 September 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Metro Manila, Pampanga, Bulacan, Rizal, Cavite, Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Cabiao, San Antonio, San Isidro, Gapan, Gabaldon) and Tarlac(Bamban, Concepcion).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Laguna, Batangas, Quezon, Tarlac(Anao, Capas, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Mayantoc, Moncada, San Clemente, San Jose, Santa Ignacia) and Nueva Ecija(Aliaga, Bongabon, Cabanatuan, Carranglan, Cuyapo, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Laur, Licab, Llanera, Lupao, Nampicuan, Palayan, Pantabangan, Penaranda, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, Zaragoza) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
